seo.description: Sample case study: monthly upkeep of a two-acre Deep Cove lot in North Saanich, with field mowing, hedges and photo reports to the owners.

summary: Monthly upkeep of lawns, long grass, hedges and beds on a two-acre lot.
scope: Blackberry control along the fence line
challenge: The owners of a two-acre Deep Cove lot travel for part of the year and wanted the property kept to the same standard while they were away.
approach: We set monthly visits, with extra mowing in spring growth, and a fixed list of tasks for each visit.
Blackberry was cut back from the fence line on every visit, hedges were trimmed twice a year, and the owners got photos after each visit.
result: A property kept to a set standard while the owners were away.
links: Read more about [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/), see our work in [North Saanich](/areas/north-saanich/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
